title: The application is installable and runnable locally from a documented command
statement: An operator can install and start the application on a clean machine from documented commands, and the supported deployment mode is stated rather than implied.
rationale: The product is a local-first tool a consumer clones (#1, #20, #32). An application whose supported mode is undeclared cannot be validated against the configuration it actually ships in — which is why AST-0010 is deferred rather than answered.
